{
  "name": "canvg",
  "version": "3.0.11",
  "description": "JavaScript SVG parser and renderer on Canvas.",
  "authors": [
    {
      "name": "Gabe Lerner",
      "email": "gabelerner@gmail.com"
    },

  },
  "type": "module",
  "sideEffects": false,
  "main": "lib/index.cjs",
  "module": "lib/index.es.js",

    "browser",

    "canvas"

    "regenerator-runtime": "^0.13.7",
    "rgbcolor": "^1.0.1",
    "stackblur-canvas": "^2.0.0",
    "svg-pathdata": "^6.0.3"
  },
  "files": [
    "lib"
